issue:
Deprecate __version__ and related attributes
See https://github.com/pallets/flask/issues/5230 for rationale and the linked PR for implementation.

Additionally, this will allow us to remove `packaging` as a dependency

actions.old_string:
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.metadata

from packaging.version import Version

from marshmallow.decorators import (
    post_dump,
    post_load,
    pre_dump,
    pre_load,
    validates,
    validates_schema,
)
from marshmallow.exceptions import ValidationError
from marshmallow.schema import Schema, SchemaOpts
from marshmallow.utils import EXCLUDE, INCLUDE, RAISE, missing, pprint

from . import fields

# TODO: Deprecate __version__?
__version__ = importlib.metadata.version("marshmallow")
__parsed_version__ = Version(__version__)
__version_info__: tuple[int, int, int] | tuple[
    int, int, int, str, int
] = __parsed_version__.release  # type: ignore[assignment]
if __parsed_version__.pre:
    __version_info__ += __parsed_version__.pre  # type: ignore[assignment]

import importlib.metadata
import warnings

from marshmallow.decorators import (
    post_dump,
    post_load,
    pre_dump,
    pre_load,
    validates,
    validates_schema,
)
from marshmallow.exceptions import ValidationError
from marshmallow.schema import Schema, SchemaOpts
from marshmallow.utils import EXCLUDE, INCLUDE, RAISE, missing, pprint

from . import fields

# Internal use only - not part of public API
_version = importlib.metadata.version("marshmallow")

@property
def __version__() -> str:
    warnings.warn(
        "__version__ is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.",
        DeprecationWarning,
        stacklevel=2,
    )
    return _version

@property
def __parsed_version__() -> str:
    warnings.warn(
        "__parsed_version__ is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.",
        DeprecationWarning,
        stacklevel=2,
    )
    return _version

@property
def __version_info__() -> tuple[int, ...]:
    warnings.warn(
        "__version_info__ is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.",
        DeprecationWarning,
        stacklevel=2,
    )
    # Simple version parsing without packaging dependency
    parts = _version.split(".")
    version_info = tuple(int(p) for p in parts)

import importlib.metadata
import warnings
from typing import Any

from marshmallow.decorators import (
    post_dump,
    post_load,
    pre_dump,

    validates,
    validates_schema,
)

from marshmallow.utils import EXCLUDE, INCLUDE, RAISE, missing, pprint

from . import fields

# Internal use only - not part of public API
_version = importlib.metadata.version("marshmallow")

class _VersionProperty:
    def __init__(self, name: str, getter: Any) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.getter = getter

    def __get__(self, obj: Any, objtype: Any = None) -> Any:
        warnings.warn(
            f"{self.name} is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.",
            DeprecationWarning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        return self.getter()

def _get_version() -> str:
    return _version

def _get_parsed_version() -> str:
    return _version

def _get_version_info() -> tuple[int, ...]:
    parts = _version.split(".")
    return tuple(int(p) for p in parts)

__version__ = _VersionProperty("__version__", _get_version)
__parsed_version__ = _VersionProperty("__parsed_version__", _get_parsed_version)
__version_info__ = _VersionProperty("__version_info__", _get_version_info)

# Internal use only - not part of public API
_version = importlib.metadata.version("marshmallow")

def __getattr__(name: str) -> Any:
    if name == "__version__":
        warnings.warn(
            "__version__ is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.",
            DeprecationWarning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        return _version
    elif name == "__parsed_version__":
        warnings.warn(
            "__parsed_version__ is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.",
            DeprecationWarning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        return _version
    elif name == "__version_info__":
        warnings.warn(
            "__version_info__ is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.",
            DeprecationWarning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        parts = _version.split(".")
        return tuple(int(p) for p in parts)
    raise AttributeError(f"module '{__name__}' has no attribute '{name}'")
